extraction.Name: James Richard No.2
extraction.Recorded patent: Pat. Recorded 4-28-20 by Martin Abstract Co, Martin, So. Dak.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Multiple parcels deeded/sold; NWa 36-37-36 subject to Sheriff's Deed
extraction.Buyer: NE1 36-37-36 leased to Fud Ferris of Cody, Nebr. for $80.00; NWa 36-37-36 Sheriff's Deed to John J. Hess of Council Bluffs, Ia. on May 28, 1927; S½ 36-37-36 deeded to Emery R. Rusho of Winner, So. Dak. for $1.00 and other considerations; W½ 36-37-36 deeded to Raymond Cozad, Martin, So. Dak. for $1.00 and other valuable considerations; NWA 36-37-36 deeded to Homer B. Skeen of Cody, Nebr. for $500.00; NWA 36-37-36 Quit-claimed to James Richard No.3 by Homer B. Skeen & Marion E. Skeen for $1000
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: NWa 36-37-36 subject to Sheriff's Deed to John J. Hess of Council Bluffs, Ia. on May 28, 1927
extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jan. 15, 1920. Patent No. 4693. NE1 36-37-36 leased to Fud Ferris of Cody, Nebr. from 3-1-26 to 3-1-28 for $80.00 ($40.00 payable 3-1-26, balance 3-1-27); lessee to enclose tract with a 3 wire fence. S½ 36-37-36 deeded to Emery R. Rusho of Winner, So. Dak. for $1.00 and other considerations by James Richard #2 and Eva Richard, his wife, on April 27, 1920, recorded Apr. 28, 1920; subsequently deeded to Fred B. Simpson, Cody, Nebr. for $6000.00 by Emery R. Rusho, a widower, on July 20, 1920, recorded July 27, 1920; then deeded to Walter Bell by Fred Simpson & Mollie B. Simpson for $1.00 and other valuable considerations on Feb. 9, 1921, recorded Mar. 11, 1921; then deeded back to Fred B. Simpson by Walter Bell & Elsie M. Bell for $1.00 and other valuable considerations on Mar. 20, 1925, recorded Mar. 21, 1925. W½ 36-37-36 deeded to Raymond Cozad, Martin, So. Dak. for $1.00 and other valuable considerations by James Richard 2, Sep. 30, 1921, recorded Nov. 23, 1921. NWA 36-37-36 deeded to Homer B. Skeen of Cody, Nebr. for $500.00 by James Richard No.2 and Eva Richard, his wife, on May 26, 1922, recorded June 1, 1922; then Quit-claimed to James Richard No.3 by Homer B. Skeen & Marion E. Skeen for $1000 on June 3, 1922, recorded 2-16-23. Document taken from records at the County Seat. Wife named Eva Richard.
